pluginText.pf.rules: {"contract":"A written contract for project work where the state's rules require one, signed by everyone on the deed and by the business before any money","contract_parts":"The parts the state's form lists (license number, dates, price, deposit, cancel notice, any lien notice)","cancel_window":"A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; work and orders wait for it","permits":"Pulled by the license holder in the business's name, never the homeowner's","change_orders":"Written and signed by both before the changed work","final":"The final check and any permit sign-off before the last payment","lien_waivers":"Lien waivers from the business and its subcontractors with the last payment, where the state's rules provide them","show":"The license number on the listing, the quote, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it","warranty":"1 year on workmanship (the example's); makers' warranties on boards, railings and hardware. Wood checks, moves and fades as it weathers; that is not a defect, and the contract says what is covered.","records":"7 years"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"weather":"Rain or a soaked yard on a footing day, or rain on a staining day: the day moves, with no fee; the crew lead checks the forecast the day before","materials_late":"Boards, composite or railing kits are late: wait, or switch to an in-stock item with the owner's yes, or move the day, with no fee to the customer","association_late":"The owners' association is slow: the start moves with no fee; Alex is told","hidden_conditions":"Rotted joists, a rotted house rim board or rock found when the old deck comes off or a footing is dug: a change order before the fix","line_in_the_way":"A marked utility line is in the way: the crew plans around it; the start may move a day or two","permit_late":"The start moves with no fee; Alex is told","inspection_fails":"The crew fixes it and it's checked again; the next stage and its bill wait","wood_movement":"New wood checks, cups and fades as it dries; the quote says so","cancel_after_window":"Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own","nobody_home":"Estimates, cleaning and sealing with the gate open, with start and end photos","over_license_limit":"Not offered, and the owner is told why","walk_through_dispute":"Goes to Sam; the last bill waits","other":"All other edge cases are handled the generic way"}
